It features RCA tube components inside, including glass vacuum tubes with Silvertone and RCA markings visible through the back panel opening. The radio has a black textured exterior with metal control knobs for volume and station selection. The front includes a three-section cloth speaker grille. The top of the unit has a black leather carrying handle attached with metal hardware. The radio shows visible wear, scuffs, and some rust on metal parts consistent with its age. It is a collectible piece likely from the early-to-mid 20th century and is in used, unrestored condition.

282771712.description:
Brazilian Agate Geode Bookend
Polished Natural Agate with Blue Enhancement
Mid-to-Late 20th Century Lapidary Decor
This natural Brazilian agate geode section has been cut and polished to highlight intricate concentric banding and a crystalline quartz core, enhanced with a vibrant blue dye treatment. Popularized during the mid-to-late 20th century as functional desk accessories and display specimens, cut geode bookends highlight organic geological formations alongside geometric lapidary craftsmanship.
Natural agate geode featuring fine banding surrounding a crystalline quartz center
Polished front face and upright surface with preserved natural rough rind on the exterior
Equipped with three protective green felt pads on the base to prevent surface scratching
Measures approximately 5 inches tall, 3.5 inches long, and 2.5 inches wide, weighing 2.1 lbs
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The polished faces display a smooth, lustrous finish with clearly defined banding. The rough exterior shows typical geological texture and variations inherent to natural stone formation. Base felt pads are intact. Free of chips, cracks, or damage beyond natural mineral characteristics.

282860881.description:
You are purchasing a "Mixed Crystal and Mineral Specimen Lot with Amethyst and Quartz" in "Used" condition.
Beautiful mixed lot of natural crystals and mineral specimens, perfect for collectors, crystal healers, crafters, or anyone who loves unique stones. This assortment includes a variety of clear and smoky quartz points, polished and raw amethyst pieces, geode and agate slices, small clusters, and rough matrix specimens. The largest amethyst cluster is a striking display piece, and several of the quartz points are substantial in size, making them great for altars, decor, grids, or photography props. The collection offers a nice range of textures and shapes: from polished wands and points to raw, sparkly clusters and rugged matrix. Ideal as a starter collection, to resell individually, or to add depth and interest to an existing crystal display. Please note: this listing is for the entire lot shown together, including multiple individual stones and clusters in varying sizes. Keywords: crystal lot, mineral collection, quartz points, amethyst cluster, geode slice, agate slice, raw crystals, polished crystal, metaphysical decor, altar stones, specimen lot
Condition Notes:
Lot of assorted crystals and mineral specimens including clear quartz points and clusters, amethyst points and clusters, geode halves, small tumbled pieces, and rough matrix stones. Surfaces show natural inclusions, internal fractures, and variations in color typical of mineral specimens. Some edges and tips have minor chips and rough spots. Matrix pieces have uneven, rough backs with natural pitting and texture. Overall presents as a mixed collection of display and healing stones with normal handling and storage wear.
